title: 第10课 · 别找了，手机在桌子上呢
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 10 — 别找了，手机在桌子上呢 · Stop looking for your cell phone; it's on the desk

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：不要看电视了，明天上午还有汉语课呢。
items.py: A: Búyào kàn diànshì le, míngtiān shàngwǔ hái yǒu Hànyǔ kè ne.
items.en: A: Stop watching TV. You have a Chinese class tomorrow morning.

items.zh: B：看电视对学汉语有帮助。
items.py: B: Kàn diànshì duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu bāngzhù.
items.en: B: Watching TV helps with learning Chinese.

items.zh: A：明天的课你都准备好了吗？
items.py: A: Míngtiān de kè nǐ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
items.en: A: Are you ready for tomorrow's lessons?

items.py: B: Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
items.en: B: Yes, all ready.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在医院 — In the hospital

items.zh: A：别看报纸了，医生说你要多休息。
items.py: A: Bié kàn bàozhǐ le, yīshēng shuō nǐ yào duō xiūxi.
items.en: A: Stop reading the paper. The doctor said you need more rest.

items.zh: B：好，不看了。给我一杯茶吧。
items.py: B: Hǎo, bú kàn le. Gěi wǒ yì bēi chá ba.
items.en: B: OK, I'll stop. Give me a cup of tea.

items.zh: A：医生说吃药后两个小时不要喝茶。
items.py: A: Yīshēng shuō chī yào hòu liǎng ge xiǎoshí búyào hē chá.
items.en: A: The doctor said no tea for two hours after the medicine.

items.py: B: Yīshēng hái shuō shénme le?
items.en: B: What else did the doctor say?

items.py: A: Yīshēng ràng nǐ tīng wǒ de.
items.en: A: The doctor said you should listen to me.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家里 — At home

items.zh: A：你怎么买了这么多东西啊？
items.py: A: Nǐ zěnme mǎile zhème duō dōngxi a?
items.en: A: Why did you buy so many things?

items.zh: B：哥哥今天中午回来吃饭。
items.py: B: Gēge jīntiān zhōngwǔ huílai chī fàn.
items.en: B: Our elder brother is coming home for lunch today.

items.zh: A：我看看买什么了。羊肉、鸡蛋、面条、西瓜……真不少！妈妈呢？
items.py: A: Wǒ kànkan mǎi shénme le. Yángròu, jīdàn, miàntiáo, xīguā…… zhēn bù shǎo! Māma ne?
items.en: A: Let me see. Mutton, eggs, noodles, watermelon… that's a lot! Where's Mum?

items.py: B: Zhèngzài zhǔnbèi wǔfàn ne!
items.en: B: She's making lunch!

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Nǐ zài zhǎo shénme?
items.en: A: What are you looking for?

items.zh: B：你看见我的手机了吗？白色的。
items.py: B: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de shǒujī le ma? Báisè de.
items.en: B: Have you seen my phone? The white one.

items.zh: A：别找了，手机在桌子上呢，电脑旁边。
items.py: A: Bié zhǎo le, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shang ne, diànnǎo pángbiān.
items.en: A: Stop looking, it's on the desk next to the computer.

items.zh: B：你看见我的衣服了吗？红色的那件。
items.py: B: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de yīfu le ma? Hóngsè de nà jiàn.
items.en: B: Have you seen my top? The red one.

items.zh: A：那件衣服我帮你洗了，在外边呢。
items.py: A: Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ le, zài wàibian ne.
items.en: A: I washed it for you, it's outside.

items.py: Pǎo bù duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.
items.en: Running is good for your health.

items.py: Lǎoshī duì xuésheng fēicháng hǎo.
items.en: The teacher is very good to the students.

items.zh: 看电视对学汉语有帮助。
items.py: Kàn diànshì duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu bāngzhù.
items.en: Watching TV helps with learning Chinese.

items.py: Háizimen zhèngzài zuò shénme?
items.en: What are the children doing?

items.zh: 妈妈为什么不让他们看电视了？
items.py: Māma wèi shénme bú ràng tāmen kàn diànshì le?
items.en: Why won't Mum let them watch TV any more?

items.py: Chī yào yǐhòu kěyǐ hē chá ma?
items.en: Can you drink tea after taking the medicine?

items.zh: 他今天都买了什么东西？为什么要买这么多？
items.py: Tā jīntiān dōu mǎile shénme dōngxi? Wèi shénme yào mǎi zhème duō?
items.en: What did he buy today, and why so much?

items.zh: 你知道男的正在找什么吗？
items.py: Nǐ zhīdào nán de zhèngzài zhǎo shénme ma?
items.en: Do you know what the man is looking for?

items.zh: 中国人喜欢喝茶，茶对身体有好处。
items.py: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan hē chá, chá duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.
items.en: Chinese people love tea; it's good for your health.

items.zh: 中国茶有很多种：红茶、绿茶、青茶、花茶。
items.py: Zhōngguó chá yǒu hěn duō zhǒng: hóngchá, lǜchá, qīngchá, huāchá.
items.en: There are many kinds: black, green, oolong and scented tea.

items.zh: 春天喝花茶，夏天喝绿茶，秋天喝青茶，冬天喝红茶。
items.py: Chūntiān hē huāchá, xiàtiān hē lǜchá, qiūtiān hē qīngchá, dōngtiān hē hóngchá.
items.en: Scented tea in spring, green in summer, oolong in autumn, black in winter.

items.zh: 来中国一定要体验一下中国的茶文化。
items.py: Lái Zhōngguó yídìng yào tǐyàn yíxià Zhōngguó de chá wénhuà.
items.en: If you visit China, be sure to try its tea culture.
